name: Peach Marmalade
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: dry light coloured brown sugar to two of peaches
ingredients.originalText: one pound of dry light coloured brown sugar to two of peaches

instructions.text: Take the ripest soft peaches, (the yellow ones make the prettiest marmalade,) pare them, and take out the stones
put them in the pan with one pound of dry light coloured brown sugar to two of peaches
when they are juicy, they do not require water
with a silver or wooden spoon, chop them with the sugar
continue to do this, and let them boil gently till they are a transparent pulp, that will be a jelly when cold

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take the ripest soft peaches, (the yellow ones make the prettiest marmalade,) pare them, and take out the stones
2. put them in the pan with one pound of dry light coloured brown sugar to two of peaches
3. when they are juicy, they do not require water
4. with a silver or wooden spoon, chop them with the sugar
5. continue to do this, and let them boil gently till they are a transparent pulp, that will be a jelly when cold
